    - CALCULATIONS: 
        MIN_DOWN = PROP_VALUE * 0.15
        MONTHLY_RATE = INTEREST_RATE / 1200
        MONTHLY_PAYMENT = LOAN_AMOUNT * monthly_rate / (1 - (1 + monthly_rate)**(-term_months))
        Use ROUNDED for all financial computations.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. MORTGAGE-PROCESSOR.

ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT INPUT-FILE ASSIGN TO '/app/src/INPUT.DAT'

    SELECT OUTPUT-FILE ASSIGN TO '/app/data/OUTPUT.DAT'
        ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.

FILE SECTION.

01  INPUT-REC.
    05  IN-ID               PIC X(10).
    05  IN-NAME             PIC X(30).
    05  IN-LOAN-AMOUNT      PIC 9(10).
    05  IN-PROP-VALUE       PIC 9(10).
    05  IN-DOWN-PAYMENT     PIC 9(10).
    05  IN-TERM             PIC 9(2).
    05  IN-RATE             PIC 9(3)V9(2).
FD  OUTPUT-FILE.
01  OUTPUT-REC            PIC X(200).

WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01  WS-MIN-DOWN            PIC 9(10)V9(2).
01  WS-MONTHLY-RATE       PIC 9(5)V9(6).
01  WS-MONTHLY-PAYMENT    PIC 9(10)V9(2).
01  WS-BALANCE            PIC 9(10)V9(2).
01  WS-INTEREST           PIC 9(10)V9(2).
01  WS-PRINCIPAL          PIC 9(10)V9(2).
01  WS-MONTH-NUM          PIC 9(3).
01  WS-REASON             PIC X(50).
01  WS-STATUS             PIC X(5).
01  WS-SPACE              PIC X VALUE SPACE.

    OPEN INPUT INPUT-FILE
    OPEN OUTPUT OUTPUT-FILE
    PERFORM UNTIL EOF

        END-READ
    END-PERFORM
    CLOSE INPUT-FILE
    CLOSE OUTPUT-FILE
    STOP RUN.

             IN-DOWN-PAYMENT, IN-TERM, IN-RATE.

        END-STRING
        WRITE OUTPUT-REC

        STRING IN-ID WS-STATUS INTO OUTPUT-REC END-STRING
        WRITE OUTPUT-REC
        MOVE IN-LOAN-AMOUNT TO WS-BALANCE

        COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-PAYMENT = IN-LOAN-AMOUNT * WS-MONTHLY-RATE /
            (1 - (1 + WS-MONTHLY-RATE) ** (- IN-TERM)) ROUNDED
        PERFORM VARYING WS-MONTH-NUM FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-MONTH-NUM > IN-TERM
            COMPUTE WS-INTEREST = WS-BALANCE * WS-MONTHLY-RATE ROUNDED
            COMPUTE WS-PRINCIPAL = WS-MONTHLY-PAYMENT - WS-INTEREST ROUNDED
            SUBTRACT WS-PRINCIPAL FROM WS-BALANCE GIVING WS-BALANCE ROUNDED
            MOVE WS-MONTH-NUM TO WS-MONTH-NUM
            STRING
                FUNCTION REVERSE(FUNCTION TRIM(WS-MONTH-NUM))
                " "
                WS-MONTHLY-PAYMENT " "
                WS-INTEREST " "
                WS-PRINCIPAL " "
                WS-BALANCE
                INTO OUTPUT-REC
            END-STRING
            WRITE OUTPUT-REC
        END-PERFORM
    END-IF.
EOF
